title: console AI dock: the chat request names the selected app (activeApp, not the constant 'AI') and the page/record in view (surface) on every surface, the floating dock included (objectstack half of cloud#3564)
body:
repo:cloud#2 · os-zhuang · session_0123kRqqdpAJWYMgsgdAJX4G

Filing gate ①, the objectstack half of objectstack-ai/cloud#3564. That card is a defect measured on staging and production: the AI chat loses the user's app and record context. Its card asked triage to split this half out "with these facts". ⛔ Not a claim.

## 维护者速读

聊天框发给 AI 的请求里，`activeApp` 写死成 `'AI'`，而且悬浮聊天框（dock）不带当前页面和记录（`surface`）。所以助手不知道用户正在哪个应用、哪条记录上：问「这条记录的负责人是谁」会被反问「哪条记录」，问「这个应用怎么用」会答成别的应用。本卡只改控制台发出的请求体；agent 怎么用这些上下文是 cloud 那一半（cloud#3564）的事。

## Where (objectstack `main`)

- `ui/packages/app-shell/src/console/ai/AiChatPage.tsx` ~1895: `context: { activeApp: 'AI', … }`, a constant.
- The same block adds `surface` only when `surfaceContext` exists (cloud#1610). The floating dock's captured request body had no `surface` on an object list page. Measured on staging cloud `419ee51b` / objectstack 18.3.0, by scripting the dock's own body: `{activeApp:"AI", agentName:"build", autoPublishAiBuilds:true, packageId:"app.jpph"}`.

## Do

1. `activeApp` carries the app the person has selected in the dock's app picker (the same value as `packageId` when one is selected), never the literal `'AI'`. With no app selected, omit it. Do not send a placeholder.
2. Every chat surface, the floating dock included, sends `surface` for the page in view: an object list (the object), a record page (object + record id + record name), or a dashboard or report. Use the existing cloud#1610 shape; do not add a second one.
3. The value is read per send, so navigating while the dock is open updates it on the next turn.

## Done when

- A unit/component test pins the request body: on a record page, the dock's body carries `surface` with the object and record id and `activeApp` = the selected app. With nothing selected, there is no `activeApp: 'AI'`.
- `useObjectChat.transportIdentity.test.tsx`'s fixture no longer models `activeApp: 'AI'` as the expected shape.
- cloud then measures the scenarios on cloud#3564 (10/10 per ask) after a pin round.

## Business reason

The chat is the trial owner's first surface. It asks 「哪个应用 / 哪条记录」 when the screen already shows both. The maintainer hit this in production (cloud#3564, conversation `conv_582a4d64…`).

## Reader who acts

The lane owning `ui/packages/app-shell` (console AI).

## Dedupe

- `chat dock activeApp surface context`: 2 hits. #21968 (closed, App.defaultAgent docs) and #6015 (a triage seat thread). Neither is this.
- `dock request surface record context`: 9 hits, none about the dock's request body.
